dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete AWS‑specific thresholds (85% flood‑stage, 75% heap pressure, 20 shards per node), exact default watermarks, and detailed probe commands that a generic model would not enumerate; however it omits a few niche failure modes (e.g., VPC endpoint throttling) so not a perfect 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific mindset (resource‑pressure first, then mapping/queries) and detailed procedures for each layer, including exact CLI commands. Missing depth in split‑brain detection (only a brief note) and UltraWarm migration steps, so deduct 2 points.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., never clear flood‑stage block before disk <95%). One minor gap: no explicit warning about ignoring IAM policy changes, which are out of scope but could be mentioned.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete frontmatter, clear description, when‑to‑use/when‑not‑to‑use, activation triggers, invocation schema and example. The schema is described in prose rather than a strict JSON schema, so deduct 1 point.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (quick start, mindset, step‑by‑step), but the quick‑start section front‑loads many details (threshold tables, probe commands) which can cause cognitive overload. Deduct 3 points for insufficient early pruning.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated by explicit CONFIRM prompts and safety checks. Slight over‑confidence in allowing max_shards_per_node changes without a pre‑check leads to a 1‑point deduction.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (quick start → mindset → symptom table → stepwise process → anti‑patterns → safety). Minor ad‑hoc elements (e.g., mixed markdown tables) prevent a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a deterministic output format, decision trees, concrete CLI/API commands, and error‑handling (INSUFFICIENT_DATA). Missing a few edge‑case branches (e.g., partial metric loss) prevents a perfect score.
